sloka: तथा भूता हि सा चर्या न शापः तत्र मुच्यते ।स्व पुत्रम् राज शार्दूल रामम् सत्य पराक्रमम् ॥१-१९-८॥
transliteration: tathā bhūtā hi sā caryā na śāpaḥ tatra mucyate ।sva putram rāja śārdūla rāmam satya parākramam ॥1-19-8॥

translations.english: O tiger among kings it is befitting of you to entrust your eldest son Rama to me who is valiant, young (having sidelocks of hair) and true to his prowess.
